content.short: Abstract Chain is an advanced decentralized protocol designed for seamless layer 2 blockchains within the Web3 ecosystem on Ethereum.
content.description: A Layer 2 network built on ZK Stack for consumer applications. As a prominent player in the Blockchains space, Abstract Chain specializes in delivering high-quality layer 2 blockchains infrastructure. It natively supports interactions on Ethereum, utilizing modern smart contract standards to ensure capital efficiency and robust security. The platform is dedicated to lowering the barrier to entry for both developers and retail participants. Moving forward, Abstract Chain focuses on expanding its decentralized capabilities to offer unparalleled utility in the ever-growing blockchain industry.
content.meta: Abstract Chain provides innovative layer 2 blockchains tools for the Blockchains space. Discover Abstract Chain and other decentralized applications on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
